messages.content:
Two things about relay-config keep slowing down our deploys. Every setting has to be
set, even the ones that almost never change, and when several settings are wrong,
envcheck only reports the first one, so people fix them one deploy at a time. Please:

- let a field declare a default with a `default` option, given as the typed value:
  `integer({ default: 8080 })`, `boolean({ default: false })`, `list({ default: [] })`,
  a duration in milliseconds, and so on for every field builder in src/fields.ts.
  loadConfig should use the default when the variable is unset or empty. A value that
  is set but cannot be read is still an error, and a field without a default stays
  required;
- make loadConfig check every variable before it gives up. It should throw one
  ConfigError with an `issues` list that has one `{ variable, message }` entry per
  missing or unreadable variable, in schema order, where `message` is the text that
  follows the variable name in today's error (for example
  `{ variable: "RELAY_PORT", message: 'expected an integer, got "80a"' }`). envcheck
  should print one `envcheck: NAME: message` line per issue on stderr and exit with
  status 2 as it does now;
- the platform team has put the defaults for the relay's settings in
  config/defaults.json. loadRelayConfig and envcheck should use them, so that the relay
  starts with only RELAY_UPSTREAM_URL and RELAY_SIGNING_SECRET set.

An environment that sets every variable should load exactly as it does today, and a
single problem should still give the same message and exit status as now.
